Notes.Text:
This update for AppStream fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-136413: infinite loop via integer wraparound in asc_l10n_parse_data_qt() can lead to denial of service
  (bsc#1291668).
- CVE-2026-136414: division-by-zero in asc_read_translation_status() can lead to process crash (bsc#1291669).

Vulnerabilities.Description: AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in asc_l10n_parse_data_qt() that allows attackers to hang compose runs by supplying unchecked tag lengths in Qt .qm files. Attackers can place a crafted .qm file with a 0xFFFFFFFB tag length, referenced by a component's qt translation element, to wrap the read offset and hang appstreamcli compose indefinitely.

Vulnerabilities.Description: AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains a division by zero vulnerability in asc_read_translation_status() in compose/asc-utils-l10n.c that allows attackers to crash compose runs via crafted Qt .qm files. Attackers can supply a valid .qm file with no TRANSLATION records, triggering SIGFPE that terminates the entire appstreamcli compose or libappstream-compose process.
